# submitnow — Full Reference

> Free multilingual web UI, browser-first utilities, zero-dependency CLI & MCP server, and technical documentation for submitting URL batches via IndexNow to Bing, ChatGPT Search, Microsoft Copilot, Yandex, Seznam.cz, Naver, and Yep.

- Canonical Site: `https://submitnow.dev`
- Languages: English (`https://submitnow.dev/`), Simplified Chinese (`https://submitnow.dev/zh`), Japanese (`https://submitnow.dev/ja`)
- Source Repository: `https://github.com/overstarry/indexNow-gui`
- XML Sitemap: `https://submitnow.dev/sitemap.xml`

---

## 1. Core Submission Workflow

submitnow forwards IndexNow batch submission requests server-side to `https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow` (or a selected partner endpoint: Bing, Yandex, Seznam.cz, Naver, Yep) without storing submitted keys or URL lists in an application database.

1. **Generate a key** (`https://submitnow.dev/tools/indexnow-key-generator`): Create an 8–128 character key containing only `a-z`, `A-Z`, `0-9`, and `-`, then download `<key>.txt`.
2. **Host the key file**: Publish `<key>.txt` at `https://<host>/<key>.txt` returning `HTTP 200`, `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`, and a body containing only the exact key (no `.txt` suffix inside the body, no HTML, no UTF-8 BOM).
3. **Verify public accessibility** (`https://submitnow.dev/tools/indexnow-key-checker`): Confirm no 404, soft-404 HTML, WAF challenge, or off-host redirect interferes with external verification. Server-side fetches enforce SSRF protections and rate limits.
4. **Import, normalize & diff URLs** (`https://submitnow.dev`, `https://submitnow.dev/tools/url-normalizer`, `https://submitnow.dev/tools/indexnow-batch-builder`, `https://submitnow.dev/tools/sitemap-diff`): Fetch live `sitemap.xml`, `.xml.gz`, or nested `<sitemapindex>` files with optional `lastmod` filtering (24h/7d/30d), compare snapshots for added/changed/removed URLs, normalize queries, and split by hostname or 10,000-URL chunks.
5. **Submit or automate** (`https://submitnow.dev`, `https://submitnow.dev/tools/indexnow-code-generator`, `https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/cli-and-mcp`): Submit directly from the web UI (auto-chunking lists > 10,000 URLs), export JSON/`curl`/JavaScript/Python/Go/GitHub Actions snippets, or run the local CLI (`cli/submitnow.ts`) and stdio MCP server (`mcp/server.ts`).

### Standard IndexNow Payload

```json
{
  "host": "www.example.com",
  "key": "your-indexnow-key",
  "keyLocation": "https://www.example.com/your-indexnow-key.txt",
  "urlList": [
    "https://www.example.com/page-1",
    "https://www.example.com/page-2"
  ]
}
```

---

## 2. HTTP Status Code Reference

- **200 OK** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/200`): Request accepted and key validated. Confirms receipt, not guaranteed indexing.
- **202 Accepted** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/202`): Request accepted; asynchronous key verification pending. Do not retry in a tight loop.
- **400 Bad Request** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/400`): Malformed JSON, invalid key format/length, missing fields, or invalid `urlList`. Fix payload before retrying.
- **403 Forbidden** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/403`): Key not valid or key file unreachable/mismatched (check BOM, soft 404, WAF challenges, off-host redirects).
- **422 Unprocessable Entity** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/422`): URLs do not belong to `host` (e.g., apex vs. `www` mismatch) or violate subdirectory `keyLocation` prefix scope.
- **429 Too Many Requests** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/429`): Rate limited. Deduplicate URLs, send sitemap diffs only, coordinate publishers, and apply exponential backoff with jitter.

---

## 3. Platform Integration & AI Search Guides

- **AI Search & `robots.txt`** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/guides/ai-search-robots-txt`): How Bing's index supports Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT Search; separating `Bingbot` / `OAI-SearchBot` from `GPTBot` in `robots.txt`.
- **WordPress** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/wordpress`): Run a single maintained IndexNow publisher and exclude draft/noindex archives.
- **Next.js** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/nextjs`): Serve `public/<key>.txt`, exclude dotted static files from middleware matchers, and submit post-deploy sitemap diffs.
- **Cloudflare Workers** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/cloudflare-workers`): Serve `/<key>.txt` at the edge, submit asynchronously with `ctx.waitUntil()`, and bypass WAF challenges on the key file path.
- **Shopify** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/shopify`): Avoid `cdn.shopify.com` off-host redirect and App Proxy subdirectory scope traps using Cloudflare O2O/Workers or Hydrogen + product webhooks.
- **GitHub Actions** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/github-actions`): Post-deploy key verification and delta-only submission with `INDEXNOW_KEY` secrets.
- **Astro, Hugo & Static Sites** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/astro-hugo`): Static key file placement and canonical trailing-slash alignment.
- **CLI & MCP Server** (`https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/cli-and-mcp`): Run `node cli/submitnow.ts` in terminals/CI or connect `node mcp/server.ts` to Claude Code, Cursor, or Antigravity (`indexnow_generate_key`, `indexnow_check_key`, `indexnow_fetch_sitemap`, `indexnow_submit_urls`).
